            For artists

            Your music. Your fans. Your money.

            Most artists rent their audience from Instagram, YouTube and flyers. We build you your own home: one place for your songs, videos, shows and drops, and a fan list you own. You decide what goes out, when, and how you get paid.

            • Your own fan listFans join on WhatsApp. On drop day they hear from you directly, not from an algorithm.
            • Control what you releasePre-listens for your list, release dates you set, and your whole catalog in one place.
            • Ways to earnTicket links for every show, merch drops, paid early access and booking requests from promoters and brands.
            • Lava works for you tooAnswers fans about shows and tickets day and night. Anything about money or bookings goes to your manager first.

            How it works

            From first message to launch.

            1. 01

              Tell us about your business

              A short WhatsApp chat or call. What you sell, who buys it, and what eats your time.

            2. 02

              We design and build

              You see your site on your own phone first, and we change it until it feels right.

            3. 03

              Lava learns your business

              We load your menu, rooms or stock and agree what Lava may answer alone.

            4. 04

              Launch, then we stay

              We keep the site and the assistant running and update them when your business changes.

            Questions owners ask

            Will it work on cheap phones and mobile data?

            Yes. We design for phones first, keep pages light, and test on a slow connection before launch.

            Does Lava send messages without me?

            Only routine answers you have agreed to, like opening hours or what is on the menu. Bookings, orders and anything about money wait for your OK.

            Which apps does it work with?

            WhatsApp Business, Instagram and Facebook Page messages. WhatsApp runs on Meta's official WhatsApp Business Platform, which can carry small message fees from Meta. We explain these before you start.

            Do I need a website first?

            No. We can build both together, or start with just the assistant.

            How much does it cost?

            It depends on what you need. Tell us about your business and we will send a clear quote.
